attributes.action: Ban public sale of fireworks and require licenses for displays
attributes.background: While we live in a country where it is illegal to play music on a train because it's a nuisance, why is it ok for anyone to be able to go to their local supermarket and buy explosives to let off whenever/wherever they like? With rising violence using fireworks and  antisocial use, restrict sales.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
